## Overview

Use this page as the short path for creating PrairieLearn content for ETF use.

## Typical workflow

- Plan the learning objective or assessment goal.
- Build the PrairieLearn question or activity.
- Add the content to the right course or exam set.
- Test it before sharing it with students or staff.
